verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents some built-in automatic rules. Sandbox schedules run commands on a cron schedule, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with per-run history. Expiration policies auto-delete sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions, and jobs can run on a schedule. These are mostly time- or inactivity-based triggers tied to specific features, not a general event-to-action rule system. Missing for 10: general user-defined event triggers (e.g. webhooks or resource-state events) mapped to arbitrary actions, a unified rules/automation engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
